title: melandrium apricum var. oldhamianum
intro: Melandrium apricum var. oldhamianum, commonly known as Rock Cress or Creeping Thyme, is a perennial flowering plant that belongs to the family Caryophyllaceae. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving respiratory issues due to its expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of Melandrium apricum var. oldhamianum include its use as an antiseptic, anti-inflammatory, and expectorant agent, helping to relieve coughs, colds, and bronchitis. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
